findings.conclusion: One fixed UTC00/30 slot per stage-anchored two-day block; final singleton samples exactly 48 slots. 219 days gives 110 pre-cancellation opportunities, not 110 issued/completed trades.

SHA256 input is fixed salt + full 32-byte declaration seed + 8-byte big-endian block start + 4-byte counter. Acceptance strictly below the largest multiple of 48/96 below 2**256 avoids modulo bias under the SHA pseudorandom assumption; no process RNG or prices enter the schedule.

Joins by original scheduled_ms from causal dense-clock audit, not delayed decision_ms. Exact M1 confirmation/freshness/spread and same-run exact M5 ATR come from unchanged dense wrapper. Missing, stale, wide-spread, missing-ATR or run-break selected slots remain cancelled; later dense slots do not substitute.

Direction, decision, horizon, stop and target are copied unchanged. Audit carries original scheduled close, seed, block bounds and accepted digest. No selection by payoff, coverage, reservation or scenario occurs in this function.
Finally closes underlying dense iterator. Independently exercised normal exhaustion, upstream exception, downstream close and downstream throw; no suffix consumption on early close.

external_contracts_not_proven_by_this_mo: Caller must freeze one complete declaration and its canonical SHA before any strategy/final measurements, then retain the generated schedule receipt; the function validates hash syntax, not provenance or absence of seed grinding.
Same stage calendar/hash must be passed unchanged across policies and BASE/STRESS. Changing declared end/seed after results is outside the supported frozen contract.
Embargo/reservation, stage masks and UNKNOWN stop behavior are explicitly delegated to the evaluator and were not audited in this limited module review.
No timing choice can establish economic edge; reduced clock density changes the comparator claim and does not imply superiority over dense CLOCK.
Private helper _uniform_slot is exercised for public-path 48 and 96 slots only.
